title: Ludwig angina / airway-threatening floor-of-mouth swelling
logic: Bilateral submandibular swelling with raised/woody floor of mouth, protruding or elevated tongue, drooling, voice change, or difficulty lying flat — usually with a dental source
action: Critical alert: airway team summoned before any other action; nurse sitting up, do not sedate; theatre planned with awake-intubation/surgical-airway capability; decompression and dental source removal follow airway control — antibiotics alone are not a plan

title: Retrobulbar haemorrhage after facial fracture or its reduction
logic: Increasing orbital pain, proptosis, falling visual acuity, or fixed dilated pupil in the hours after zygomatic/orbital fracture or its surgical reduction
action: Sight is lost in under an hour: immediate senior call and lateral canthotomy/cantholysis pathway; do not send for imaging first; this is why hourly eye observations are scheduled after zygoma surgery

title: Airway risk in the maxillomandibular-fixed patient
logic: Patient in wire MMF with vomiting, respiratory distress, falling saturations or reduced conscious level
action: Cut the INTERMAXILLARY wires immediately with the bedside wire cutters (not the arch bars), suction, and position for airway safety; every MMF patient carries wire cutters and every receiving ward is briefed — absence of cutters at the bedside is a reportable safety defect

title: Le Fort level assignment for midface fractures
logic: Midface fracture recorded without a Le Fort level (I palate-mobile, II pyramidal with nasofrontal involvement, III craniofacial disjunction) or an explicit 'not classifiable/comminuted' note
action: Prompt level assignment from mobility examination and imaging; level II/III triggers CSF-leak assessment and neurosurgical/base-of-skull consultation before fixation planning

title: Occlusion documented before and after jaw fracture treatment
logic: Mandibular or maxillary fracture operative record completed AND pre-treatment occlusion or post-reduction occlusion check is missing
action: Block operative-record completion until both are recorded — occlusion is the functional outcome measure of jaw fracture care; malocclusion discovered late means re-operation

title: Throat pack reconciliation for oral surgery
logic: Intraoral/maxillofacial procedure under general anaesthesia with a throat pack recorded as placed AND no corresponding removal record before recovery
action: Hard-stop the sign-out checklist until throat-pack removal is documented by two staff; a retained throat pack is an airway never-event

title: Antibiotics and source control for odontogenic infection
logic: Odontogenic abscess drained AND (no antibiotic with anaerobic cover recorded OR causative tooth neither extracted nor scheduled)
action: Prompt an agent with streptococcal/anaerobic cover per formulary AND a documented source-tooth plan (same-sitting extraction preferred); drainage without source control predicts re-presentation

title: Post-reduction eye observations after zygomatic/orbital surgery
logic: Zygomatic or orbital fracture reduction completed within the past 24 hours
action: Schedule eye observations (pain, proptosis, acuity, pupil reaction) hourly for 12 hours then 4-hourly to 24 hours; any deterioration routes to the retrobulbar-haemorrhage danger rule immediately

title: MMF weekly checks and release booking
logic: Maxillomandibular fixation applied AND no weekly wire/occlusion check appointments or a release date (4-6 weeks) booked
action: Auto-book weekly MMF reviews (wires, hygiene, weight) and the fixation-release visit; dietetic referral generated for the liquidised-diet period; flag missed reviews same week

title: Cleft longitudinal pathway enrolment
logic: Cleft lip and/or palate recorded at birth or repair performed AND child not enrolled on the cleft pathway (feeding review, palate-repair timing, hearing surveillance, speech assessment)
action: Enrol on the cleft multidisciplinary pathway with milestone bookings: feeding/weight review within 2 weeks of diagnosis, palate repair listing by 9-18 months, hearing checks, speech review after palate repair; outreach/mission list linkage recorded where used
